comment: One CC assignment per line of telemetry. BOTH the firmware header and the host decoder are generated from this file, so they cannot drift apart -- the failure that made a day of page readings meaningless on 2026-09-23.

signals.name: own_lo
signals.note: this row's own mirror slot, low 7

signals.name: own_hi
signals.note: this row's own mirror slot, high 7

signals.name: dest
signals.note: the destination code in the row

signals.name: scan_idx
signals.note: which of the 16 blocks/records this burst scanned

signals.name: frame_st
signals.note: 0 read, 1 destination never copied to the frame, 2 no destination

signals.name: owner
signals.note: track whose live sound owns this voice via 0x80005308; 126 empty, 127 not a live sound

signals.name: sv_carry
signals.note: saves that wrote a non-zero LFO4, since boot, mod 128

signals.name: ld_carry
signals.note: loads that brought a non-zero LFO4 back, since boot, mod 128

signals.name: ext_live
signals.note: live LFO4 table entries, capped at 127

signals.name: ext_drop
signals.note: table entries dropped since boot, mod 128

signals.name: saves
signals.note: every sound SAVE since boot, mod 128
